rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for feeling happy or pleased.

example.english: I'm really pleased to get off work so early today.
example.traditional: 今日放工咁早，我真係好開心。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 fong3 gung1 gam3 zou2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this for the same happy or pleased feeling, especially in slightly more polished expressions.

example.english: I'm very pleased to celebrate with everyone.
example.traditional: 能夠同大家一齊慶祝，我感到好高興。
example.jyutping: nang4 gau3 tung4 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 hing3 zuk1 ngo5 gam2 dou3 hou2 gou1 hing3

rows.note: Use this when being pleased means satisfied with a result, service, or situation rather than simply happy.

example.english: I'm very pleased with the service this time.
example.traditional: 我對今次嘅服務好滿意。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 gam1 ci3 ge3 fuk6 mou6 hou2 mun5 ji3
